text.tspan: Banks now have to prove their suppliers are resilient too. Relyxus
gives you the records to prove it, and fills in their questionnaires
Do you notify us of incidents within 4 hours?
Yes. Contract clocks are tracked per client, with drafts ready.
Can you show who approved production changes?
Yes. Every change has two named approvers with passkeys.
Do you keep incident evidence unchanged?
Yes. Evidence is sealed in a ledger when collected.
Yes. Drills run against impact tolerances, with results kept.
